name: Alarm and relay status
decode: bit 0 = relay 1; bit 1 = relay 2; bit 2 = relay 3; bit 3 = relay 4; bit 4 = relay 5; bit 5 = relay 6; bit 6 = relay 7; bit 7 = relay 8; bit 8 = alarm 1; bit 9 = alarm 2; bit 10 = alarm 3; bit 11 = alarm 4; bit 12 = alarm 5; bit 13 = alarm 6; bit 14 = alarm 7; bit 15 = alarm 8; 0 = inactive; 1 = active

name: Digital I/O status
decode: bit 0 = output 1; bit 1 = output 2; bit 2 = output 3; bit 3 = output 4; bit 4 = output 5; bit 5 = output 6; bit 6 = output 7; bit 7 = output 8; bit 8 = input 1; bit 9 = input 2; bit 10 = input 3; bit 11 = input 4; bit 12 = input 5; bit 13 = input 6; bit 14 = input 7; bit 15 = input 8; 0 = inactive; 1 = active

name: PV or rate integer
interpretation: Signed 32-bit integer excluding the configured decimal point
